regression_tests.skip_meaning: All ten skips are dormant PostgreSQL cases without the approved isolated DEV database; they are NOT_RUN.

implemented: Execution/local_child_admission.py protects admission with tx.active, exact scope, existing collateral mutex (tx.require_scope), activation source, materialized original request and cumulative quantity preview.

Admission requires a trusted LocalChildCurrentFacts port covering healthy clock, current owner lease, exact active owner/epoch/policy revision, current target slice, funding preview with no blockers, authorization identity and risk clearance.

Child command is independent (no native parent command/client/venue ID) and persists command state, allocation and outbox in one transaction; replay returns the original command without a second allocation.
Quantity pool is never oversubscribed; expired lease/authority, owner change, target/funding/risk/authorization change and final-clock regression abort before returning.
Permit issuance revalidates target/funding/risk hashes against the durable command; token hash is bound, permit is single-use, and UNKNOWN retains the original command identity and blocks re-marking.

Migration 0031 is an additive dormant candidate: write history, dispatch marks, permit consumptions, unsent-abort storage, deferred completeness, quantity/unit pool guard, activation-source guard and outbox kind extension.
Migration candidate grants INSERT only to the existing ledger_owner identity; no PUBLIC/ALL grant, no transport, no runtime composition wiring.
not_run: Applying 0030/0031 to real PostgreSQL and validating triggers, FKs, grants and default privileges.
Concurrent admission under the same collateral group and no double funding/quantity allocation.
Transaction rollback after activation/command/commitment/outbox failures and process crash recovery.
Actual owner/lease/clock/risk/target/funding loader composition for local children.
UNKNOWN original-ID query/reconciliation, cancel/partial-fill races and trusted unused-allocation release.
Routing an admitted local child through the real execution owner and PAPER adapter.
API/frontend presentation of the new command state beyond the existing read-only archive view.
Any 46-capability/56-case promotion; all current-source cases remain NOT_RUN.
residual_risks: The SQL candidate is reviewed statically, not executed; trigger syntax and role semantics are unverified.
LocalChildCurrentFacts is a trusted composition port; a weak loader could still supply false facts.
The writer is intentionally not wired into server/paper runtime, so no production or PAPER order can use it yet.
No UNKNOWN recovery execution or funds release path is enabled.
Both migrations remain unapplied; deploying either requires the approved shared DEV process and a pinned TEST approval.
scope_note: Unit/contract evidence only; no database, venue, TESTNET/LIVE, real account or model call occurred.
